text:
carl: seeing a steady queue of pods Pending in ap-southeast1. lots of them stuck with nodeAffinity=spotlet and a stale reserved 'anchor' on GPUs.
leila: same. noticed evictions spike when the preemptor reclaims the spotlets -> a second wave hits the scheduler.
ops-bot: deploy alert: ap-southeast1-gpu-provisioner reports 87% allocation across small-gpu pools :warning:
carl: what's odd is the anchored leases are marked 'soft-reserve' but aren't expiring. looks like heartbeat loss to the lease manager during nic flaps.
jia: can we force-release the anchors? I can run a cleanup script but want to avoid thundering if we free a lot at once.
mike: suggest a rolling release: pick one AZ, free anchors for pods older than 12m, scale up warm nodes before release. keeps churn bounded.
leila: also saw per-node NIC tx drops coincident with these flaps — freeing anchors then causes reschedule thrash renewing the conntrack pressure.
carl: plan: (1) warm 10% extra nodes in ap-southeast1 (2) run cleanup with exponential backoff 5-30s per anchor (3) throttle scheduler bursts by setting preemptBurst=2 for 20m.
jia: I'll prepare the cleanup job. here's the dry-run command:
```
./scripts/lease-cleaner --region ap-southeast1 --age 12m --dry-run
```
mike: +1. ops-bot can we mute alerts for Allocation >85% during the ops window 10:30-11:00 UTC? we'll annotate postmortem.
ops-bot: alerts muted by @mike for 30m; note: create follow-up ticket for fix: LEASE-EXPIRY-2026.
leila: fyi adding a persistent route fix to the network team ticket — conntrack resets happened after route flap during maintenance.
carl: heads-up I'll run cleanup at 10:40 UTC and post progress here. please don't kick off mass rollouts while I'm running it. :eyes:
jia: will monitor pod pending count and NIC errors. report back in 5m after dry-run.
mike: thanks team. if this clears, we should add lease-heartbeat metrics to the console and a safeguard auto-release when heartbeat misses >3x.
leila: noted. creating console dashboard card PR after ops.
ops-bot: cleanup executed (dry-run) returned 42 anchors eligible. no action taken.
carl: going live in 2m.
